'''February 2005 Toronto tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held on Sunday 13 February 2005 at 401 Convenience, 401 Yonge Street, Toronto, Ontario, organized by [[Brandon Pahl]].<ref name="pcf-4411-60082">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60082#60082 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Feb. 13], Brandon Pahl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050223221905/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' 401 Convenience, 401 Yonge Street, Toronto, Ontario<ref name="pcf-4411-60082" />
* '''Dates:''' 13 February 2005, 11:00 AM<ref name="pcf-4411-60082" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Brandon Pahl]]<ref name="pcf-4411-60082" />
* '''Structure:''' six games, constructed, unlimited card pool; decklists mandatory<ref name="pcf-4411-60082" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="pcf-4411-60082" />

Besides a cash prize, Pahl added [[Enhanced Premiere]] and [[Jabba's Palace]] packs, rares and tournament foils, packs from various sets and uncut sheets. Every player was to receive a prize, and players outside the top three were to have random draws for prizes.<ref name="pcf-4411-61417">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=61417#61417 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Feb. 13], Brandon Pahl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050223221905/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
